ideas.idea: Add LocalBusiness/Bakery structured data and put address, hours and contact details on the page
ideas.why: The site really has no address, hours or contact details, so adding them as text is a concrete, site-specific fix, though the JSON-LD part is optional.
index.html references /img/loaves.jpg and no img folder exists in the repo, so the image may be broken.

ideas.idea: List all the loaves with descriptions and baking days on breads.html
ideas.why: The page says 'over twenty loaves' but names only two, so listing them gives readers and machines real content to quote.

ideas.idea: Give each bread its own page
ideas.why: This is a broad restructuring suggestion that is not clearly warranted for a small site and may have little effect.

ideas.why: classes.html has none of these details, and they are the first things a prospective student would ask.

ideas.idea: Explain how pre-ordering works, including cut-off time and pickup location
ideas.why: index.html mentions pre-order for weekend collection with no process, cut-off or pickup details.

ideas.idea: Add contextual links between classes and breads pages
ideas.why: The pages are already linked through the nav, so extra in-body links add little.
